scope: One resident LBVH frame from identical native triangle trajectory states, including every frame around the contact-sensitive transient
preconditions: Freshly exported native ordinary-body snapshot at the recorded start frame, with physics, contact persistence and resident LBVH buffers restored
Exactly one target frame from the bounded native triangle trajectory: four substeps, two biased PGS iterations, eight colors and sixteen deterministic Topo rounds
Frame counter and current published counts agree with the snapshot; previous contact graph, response matrices and tree storage are independently checked; capacity overflow is rejected
invariants: Device-resident collision, canonicalization, adjacency, coloring, preparation, warmstart, solve, integration, finalization and persistence; no CPU physics between stages or frames
Integer identities, memberships, copied words, allocation bijections, read-only inputs and capacity guards are exact; legal atomic allocation order is compared semantically
Active body and constraint arithmetic uses default f32 tolerances with only the explicitly named per-case, per-field numerical policy
The replayed frame checks finite normalized state, unchanged static bodies, bounded penetration and energy
Internal workspace above a published count may retain earlier-frame allocations; it is not interpreted as current state, and storage beyond the declared maximum capacity remains exact
Deferred work is stably sorted by subshape then originating pair; reduction runs before contact canonicalization
Both witnesses lie inside their shapes; normal, support distance and prediction checks apply independently of numeric parity
The replayed trajectory row equals published body state exactly; every preceding and future trajectory word, copied word, counter and guard remains exact
Contact bases are orthonormal, inertia is positive semidefinite and effective response is independently reconstructed from stored geometry
The numerical exception is tied to this exact bounded scene configuration and its required restart fixtures; other cases and unknown fields keep default tolerances
The resident LBVH program creates Morton keys, sorts, builds, refits and traverses the tree every frame. No host collision computation or brute-force pair fallback.

Independently validate final-frame Morton keys, stable sorting, graph topology, shape support bounds, refit arrivals and complete filtered overlap set for both target and native output. Integer fields and untouched storage remain exact.
Native LBVH uses a fixed 0.002 broad-phase margin. Preserve this distinct reference behavior; narrow phase still uses RbdSimParams prediction settings.
outside_scope: Long trajectory accumulation, handled by the parent general LBVH scene contract
Arbitrary runtime snapshots, adaptive capacity growth, hubs and combined joint/general-shape scenes in this isolated operation
Ascend vendor compilation, execution, memory-model and performance qualification

known_gaps.description: Paired Rust/TileLang fix 0060 rejects edge candidates whose tangent displacement cannot be represented by the implicit secondary witness. Scaled edge tests and both-witness geometric checks retain the regression; current execution evidence is still required.
Contact-sensitive long-scene drift is classified by the explicit bounded-fixture numerical policy and required identical-state restarts. Default geometry and physical checks remain mandatory.

tolerance_reason: Default float tolerances remain 2e-6 absolute / 2e-5 relative. Only the named identical-state restart cases and fields use the unchanged numerical_cases policy. Tangent response matrices use a relative Frobenius norm near zero off-diagonal entries and are independently reconstructed from geometry with the strict default tolerance. Snapshot prefix/suffix, counters, copied words, tree topology and guards remain exact.
